## Maintainer ruling (2026-08-21, live PM chat — recorded by the triage seat)

Verbatim (untranslated): 「其他接受」 — accepting the triage recommendation for this card: **option A**. The freshness gate confirms the premise is already closed: the 2026-08-20 measurement run closed all three previously-unmeasured surfaces and found `RecordHighlightsField.icon` **measured dead** at the current pin (zero read points — structurally unable to travel `useRegisterHighlightFields`; not designer-publishable — `field-list` input typed `string[]`; zero in-tree producers), while advertised in six author-facing surfaces. So the ruling executes directly as the retirement.

State: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` (`domain:spec`), dispatchable.

Dispatch notes: ADR-0087 retirement under the `spec-property-retirement` playbook. **Clause-②: yes** (narrows the authorable surface; an authored `icon` becomes a named `unrecognized_keys` refusal at publish) — dispatch at the contract-review tier per the census ACCEPT's own note (`claude-fable-5`). Scope per the census: drop `icon` from the object arm + correct the six advertisements (union describe `component.zod.ts:1013`, `RecordHighlightsProps.fields` describe `:1021`, objectui `plugin-detail/src/index.tsx` input description, `packages/lint/src/zod-issue-format.ts:25`, regen `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx:554/:589`). The objectui-side advertisement edit follows the cross-repo rule (consuming-repo follow-up card if not deliverable in the same change). Recorded confidence gap stands: out-of-tree customer apps cannot be enumerated — the retirement's loud refusal is itself the mitigation.
